interface.longDescription: Ordinary conversation with intellectual discipline. Start or join a conversation, ask naturally for a focused operation, or use GUIDE to choose among three ranked commands and MORE. Brief command cues teach the vocabulary while responses stay concise, preserve evidence scope, and expand when depth is needed. Dialectical can surface prior art, compare explanations, test assumptions, seek disconfirming evidence, show practical recipes and generic flows, and export the conversation as a reusable Markdown handoff. Operations remain optional and never form a mandatory chain. This skills-only plugin requires no external service, database, or background observer. It uses only context and host capabilities actually available.
defaultPrompt: Which Dialectical operation would help now?
Find prior art connected to this idea.
Use ACH to compare these explanations.
